external_collaboration.evidence_quote: From Big Tech to arts and culture, The Union takes an interest in all topical discussion, seeking to provide the most stimulating and critical space possible for the birth of new ideas. We’ve worked with the likes of NVIDIA, Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, IBM, The Adam Smith Institute, Accenture UK, and a range of politicians and public servants from around the world to foster innovative thinking on the most pertinent issues of the day.
